paired.scope: paired content retrieval at the same physical query bins
paired.positive_sign: weak queries retrieve later reference content than native queries

cross_key.interpretation: Attribution to changes in Q and K; does not by itself separate motion and appearance.

native.scope: sparse preRoPE content retrieval; no alpha or learned selection
native.frame_coordinate: nominal physical frame spans of position bins; not exact VAE receptive fields
native.aggregation: all observations retained; signed mean is accompanied by full spread and entropy
